description: This file contains the PHP class 'Chart' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Dashboard' namespace. It defines controller methods for managing and displaying dashboard chart data, including actions like index, save, dashboard view, and chart data retrieval. The class interacts with models and views to serve dashboard chart functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard charts in OpenCart Admin panel, offering methods to display, update, and fetch chart data including orders and customer statistics over various time ranges.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares language, breadcrumbs, view data, and renders the 'chart_form' view for the dashboard chart management interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the dashboard chart, with permission checks and JSON responses.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the dashboard chart view, passing user token for session identification.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: Generates and returns chart data in JSON format based on selected time range, pulling data from report models about orders and customers over days, weeks, months, or years.
